description: Explore Joanne Shofner's candidacy as a Conservative Republican for Texas State Representative in District 11. Discover the counties that comprise House District 11, including Nacogdoches, Newton, Panola, Rusk, Sabine, and Shelby. Stay informed about her commitment to representing the interests of these counties and contributing to the betterment of the community.
